cues.text: It's never been out of the cabinet. Well, I've taken it out. I've looked at it. I've put it back. But that's different.
'To the Elector.' -- That's you. You're the Elector now. The title comes with nothing.
Two elections are available. You may take one.
The election is irrevocable and takes effect immediately upon your indicating it, so please don't indicate anything you aren't prepared to have happen.
